item.title: Background work recovers from stale timers
item.summary: Murph now recovers when an outdated assistant timer and connected-device work become due together, so follow-through does not stay stuck behind a timer with no work left.
item.details: Current conversations, reminders, pending deliveries, and other genuinely due assistant work keep priority. Murph changes owners only after a live check confirms the projected timer is stale.
